method: Each listed item was read with its stem, all options, keyed answer(s), explanations and takeaway. Statuses are manually reasoned, not inferred from a schema or automated pass rule.
limitations: Independent AI editorial/clinical-reasoning screen; not external clinician validation or psychometric validation.
Pass applies only to the recorded content hash. New or changed content requires further review.
No comparison against proprietary examination items; originality judged from author provenance and item content.
Cross-bank learning-objective overlap remains provisional until all batches are available.
Source checks below support only the explicitly associated claims; other category references are general reading unless specifically verified.

items.assessment: New discomfort requires review of the whole prevention plan despite equipment; adaptation assumptions and extra layers are not established solutions.
Reminder integration targets demonstrated forgetting of an existing effective skill. Technique review, cushion change and waiting for pain miss the specific barrier.
All alternatives are assessment domains. Stool exposure/distribution most directly fits diffuse superficial perineal irritation rather than focal pressure loading.
Current local temperature, firmness and baseline colour change assess painful tissue beyond visible redness. Global score and old colour alone do not directly examine the current site.
Skin response and tolerance are outcomes, while pillow count and completed-turn percentage are process data. Stem now explicitly asks whether protection and tolerance are achieved.
Securement/clothing review addresses snagging while retaining function. Tight sleeve, unplanned trimming and unnecessary activity avoidance are practical but incomplete workarounds.
Remove focal constriction and assess fit; arbitrary larger sizing does not distinguish application from fit problems. Therapeutic compression does not mean maximal local pressure.
All alternatives interpret the white soggy periwound tissue. Saturated dressing supports maceration/exudate issue rather than healthy moisture, infection solely from wetness or dryness.
Temperature/hydration reassessment and dry clothing/linen address both cause and exposure. Waterproof pad or insulation while leaving damp clothing does not correct the actual moisture burden.
Safe preferred positioning can be incorporated with support/skin review. Fixed sequence, whole-shift immobility and preference without monitoring are inadequate integrations.
Duration-related discomfort informs shorter sessions with assessed relief even before visible breakdown. Extra cushion without fit review or waiting a week ignores the new response.
Device compatibility/seal effect is the relevant question. Sensitive-skin label, prior tolerance and years of use are now plausible but insufficient product assurances.
